predecessor.note: All Option-E, M1/M2/M3, and CI-companion controls from v1.0.0/v1.0.1/v1.0.2 remain in force by reference and are unchanged by this remediation. This manifest adds only the privilege-closure controls below.

live_run_source.note: Every control below was exercised for real against a disposable PostgreSQL 17 container (public.ecr.aws/supabase/postgres@sha256:80d7b27c3e8d77cfa7226eee9508671796da214781ff15a35b3670d7ad5ee453), not designed-only. Two real bugs were found and fixed during this session's iteration (a Docker-published-port false-negative in the port precheck now Docker-aware; peer-authentication failures for non-superuser roles now forced to TCP via -h 127.0.0.1; a global supabase_admin write counter now scoped per-phase; PRIV-N3's expected-to-fail sub-checks no longer counted against the overall tally) — the final run reflects the corrected script.
